module.aks_clusters:resource.azurerm_kubernetes_cluster.aks enables managed Azure AD integration but has no dependency on module.aks_clusters:resource.null_resource.register_aks_msi_preview_feature, which registers and polls the AAD-V2 feature used by this configuration. On an unregistered subscription, cluster provisioning can run before registration finishes. Order the cluster after the registration resource; the node pools will inherit that ordering through their cluster reference.

When settings.outbound_type is userDefinedRouting and the node subnet is managed here, module.aks_clusters:resource.azurerm_kubernetes_cluster.aks must wait for module.networking:resource.azurerm_subnet_route_table_association.rt. The subnet ID outputs only depend on subnet creation, not on the separate route-table association. Consequently AKS can validate/provision its UDR networking before the required route table is attached. Add ordering for UDR configurations, for example through association-dependent subnet outputs or dependencies at the root module calls.

For locally provisioned VNet-injected workspaces, module.databricks_workspaces:resource.azurerm_databricks_workspace.ws must wait for module.networking:resource.azurerm_subnet_network_security_group_association.nsg_vnet_association. Databricks requires NSGs associated with both workspace subnets before workspace creation. The networking outputs passed as var.vnet expose subnet resources but do not depend on the separate NSG associations, so subnet-name references do not enforce this prerequisite. Enforce the ordering at the root module calls or expose association-dependent subnet outputs.

When an isolated blob targets a container created by this configuration, :module.storage_account_blobs must wait for module.storage_accounts.module.container:resource.azurerm_storage_container.stg. Its storage_account_name reference only waits for the account, while storage_container_name comes directly from configuration; the separate role-assignment dependency does not guarantee container creation. Consequently blob uploads can race container creation. Wire storage_container_name through the storage account module's containers output for managed containers, or add explicit ordering at the root module calls.
